allocation_scope: Whole process including generation, expected output, warmups, verification and teardown; instrumented time/RSS excluded from comparisons.
decision: Retain only with meaningful allocation or peak-heap reduction, correctness intact, and individual latency/RSS regression flags reviewed. No registered latency claim.
hypothesis: Avoid owning plain unprefixed cell tags whose only optional attribute is r: validate all attributes as before, then retain an implicit tag because changed-cell writing always regenerates r and untouched cells are copied verbatim.
performance_claim: none; 100-sample diagnostic probe and whole-process allocation comparison
